method: Each measure scored 0-100 across the 54 countries between its 5th and 95th percentile (direction applied); a category is the weighted mean of its measures and needs at least half of its measure weight.

gni_pc_ppp.label: Income per person (GNI per capita, PPP)

startup_days.label: Days to start a business (Doing Business)

startup_procedures.label: Procedures to start a business (Doing Business)

ease_rank.label: Ease of doing business rank (Doing Business, 1 = easiest of 190)

legal_rights.label: Strength of legal rights for borrowers and lenders

total_tax_rate.label: Total tax and contribution rate on commercial profits

childcare_support.label: Childcare support (Women, Business and the Law)

parenthood_support.label: Parenthood support (Women, Business and the Law)

power_price_business.label: Business electricity price (Eurostat, 500-1,999 MWh a year)

cit_rate.label: Corporate income tax rate (headline)
cit_rate.source: Nestlyzer country tax table (OECD, national tax authorities)

growth_5y.label: Real GDP growth, average of the last five years

growth_change.label: Growth trend: last three years against 2015-2019

wage_level.label: Income per person at market prices (national proxy for labour cost, not a wage)
wage_level.source: World Bank WDI NY.GNP.PCAP.PP.CD x PA.NUS.PPPC.RF (CC BY 4.0)
